- scanner自体はraw bytes/textを全objectへ展開した別巨大treeとして保持しない。

exactRequirement: Scanner itself does not retain raw bytes/text expanded into a separate huge tree covering all objects; per-object decoded key sets, then whole JSON.parse, schema canonical regeneration and checksum in order.
distinctions: R04-13 scanner tree property is distinct from the overall16MB Safari safety gate. F6 and peak Safari measurements not attempted.
Post-parse projection/payload/canonical object copies are legitimate; count only scanner window for violation.
Low heap size or one JSON.parse alone cannot prove no second AST.
scopeAudit: Acorn independently inventories all scanner constructors, objects/arrays, producer calls, assignments and return flows; exact source whitelist plus runtime scalar observations. Does not claim a general JS theorem or alternate code support.
runtimeOracle: Heap object graph recognizer: fileFormat + snapshot.services element recordId/answers and exact service count; groups snapshot node ID. Retained and transient positive controls + allocation profiles; snapshots by phase.
